speaker: john_heminges
text: I am not ruling a line under this week. The court is not played.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three nights are looked for at Richmond. They are not received. I will not write them as if the bag had them.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The afternoon was the fourth time. A yard will want that written, even if a court has not paid it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The fourth time may be written. A share may not. I have no figure I am willing to say.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then do not invent one for the sake of a clean page.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Eleven pair of hose, you said, drying at Aldermanbury. Is drying a charge on today?

speaker: john_heminges
text: The hose are the stock's, and they are drying. Drying is not a sum. I am not entering eleven as money.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The tilt-boat has a deposit down. You did not say how much this morning. I am not asking you to say it twice.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, I am still not saying it. If she does not go Monday, there is a second deposit. That one is also not a number in this room.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Two cloaks went out of a chest on Tuesday. Prince, and Paris. Back on Innocents' night, counted.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Counted both ways. I have it. I am not losing them in a week's line, and I am not selling them to make a total.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: What I will not have on the page is a total. The coffer was not counted. It will not be counted tonight.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good. I am not adding a quarter to a total I have not opened, and I am not subtracting sixty shillings as if I had seen the canvas.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The sixty went north on Thursday, in the pack. That is a sending. It is not a balance.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Then the page is the fourth time, three nights not had, two cloaks out, a deposit unspoken. And no sum at the foot.

speaker: john_heminges
text: That is the page. New moon tonight. The almanac gives it no hour, and I will not give it one to be neat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No hour. The moon is not a share, and it does not go under one.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I can live with an unruled week if the court is the reason. I cannot live with a figure we invented to look finished.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nobody is finishing it. If she goes Monday, the boat stands. We have said so.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And if she does not, we follow her. Saying it again does not make a sum.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I am not asking for a third telling. Two is a decision. A third would be fretting.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Two is enough. God keep the Monday. I am done with the page.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then leave the book open, with no line under it. I am going before anyone finds a figure in a margin.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Open. No line. I have said the fourth time, and I will not say a fifth.

speaker: john_heminges
text: There is no fifth. Innocents is a night that is not today. Go home.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Home. The moon can come up without us counting it.
